"""Stage 7 install and the standalone ship manifest merge used by the look bench."""
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ENTRY = 'manifest_entry.json'


@contextlib.contextmanager
def project_lock(project):
    # The OS releases the lock even if the installer exits. Keep the lock file so
    # later installers always lock the same file.
    with (project / '.stage7.lock').open('a+b') as lock:
        try:
            if os.name == 'nt':
                import msvcrt
                lock.seek(0)
                msvcrt.locking(lock.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
            else:
                import fcntl
                fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except OSError as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(f'another ship install is using {project}') from exc
        yield


def sha256(path):
    with path.open('rb') as source:
        return hashlib.file_digest(source, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def verify(folder, expected):
    for name, digest in expected.items():
        if sha256(folder / name) != digest:
            raise ValueError(f'{folder / name} differs from the checked export')


def copy_verified(source, dest, digest=None):
    expected = sha256(source) if digest is None else digest
    shutil.copy2(source, dest)
    if sha256(dest) != expected:
        raise ValueError(f'copy verification failed for {dest}')


def backup_file(source, dest):
    if source.exists():
        copy_verified(source, dest)
        return dest
    return None


def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def merge_entry(entry, previous, code, dest):
    manifest = read_json(previous) if previous else dict(note='', ships={})
    manifest.setdefault('ships', {})[code] = entry
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=1), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def main(entry_path, godot, code):
    """Keep the existing manifest-only command for the look-bench overlay."""
    project = Path(godot).resolve()
    with project_lock(project):
        path = project / 'assets' / 'ships' / 'manifest.json'
        work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='manifest.bak_', dir=path.parent))
        previous = backup_file(path, work / path.name)
        entry = read_json(Path(entry_path))
        new = work / 'new.json'
        merge_entry(entry, previous, code, new)
        os.replace(new, path)
    print(f'manifest PASS: {code} written into {path} with points {entry.get("hardpoints", {})}')
    return 0


def export_snapshot(export, snapshot, code):
    # The GLB names the texture set. A previous export can leave other JPGs
    # in the same directory, so the install must never use a wildcard copy.
    from check_export import read_glb

    glb = code + '.glb'
    copy_verified(export / glb, snapshot / glb)
    doc, _ = read_glb(snapshot / glb)
    maps = {image.get('uri') for image in doc.get('images', [])}
    for name in maps:
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(re.escape(code) + r'_[\w-]+\.jpg', name):
            raise ValueError(f'unsupported export texture path {name!r}')
    for name in [ENTRY, *sorted(maps)]:
        copy_verified(export / name, snapshot / name)
    return {name: sha256(snapshot / name) for name in [glb, ENTRY, *sorted(maps)]}


def run_check(command, log, marker=None):
    with log.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as output:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    report = log.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    if marker is None or result.returncode or marker not in report:
        print(report, end='')
    if result.returncode or (marker is not None and marker not in report):
        raise RuntimeError(f'check failed. See {log}')


def install(project, code, snapshot, expected, refresh, readback):
    """Publish the checked files and roll the ship and its cache back together."""
    ship_base = project / 'assets' / 'ships'
    live = ship_base / code
    manifest = ship_base / 'manifest.json'
    gen_manifest = project / 'gen' / 'manifest.json'
    scene = project / 'gen' / 'ships' / (code + '.scn')
    files = {name: digest for name, digest in expected.items() if name != ENTRY}

    with project_lock(project):
        verify(snapshot, expected)
        ship_base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.stage7-replaced-', dir=project))
        incoming = work / 'incoming' / code
        incoming.mkdir(parents=True)
        replaced = work / 'previous'
        replaced.mkdir()
        failed = work / 'failed'
        failed.mkdir()

        def managed(name):
            return (name in files or name in {code + '_damage.glb', code + '_wreck.glb'}
                    or (name.startswith(code + '_') and name.lower().endswith('.jpg')))

        # Keep other files in the ship directory, and stage every copy and
        # manifest backup before the first live change.
        if live.exists():
            shutil.copytree(live, incoming, dirs_exist_ok=True,
                            ignore=lambda directory, names: [name for name in names if managed(name)]
                            if Path(directory) == live else [])
        for name, digest in files.items():
            copy_verified(snapshot / name, incoming / name, digest)
        previous_manifest = backup_file(manifest, replaced / 'asset_manifest.json')
        previous_cache = backup_file(gen_manifest, replaced / 'cache_manifest.json')
        entry = read_json(snapshot / ENTRY)
        verify(snapshot, expected)
        new_manifest = work / 'manifest.json'
        merge_entry(entry, previous_manifest, code, new_manifest)
        manifest_digest = sha256(new_manifest)

        def verify_install():
            verify(live, files)
            if sha256(manifest) != manifest_digest:
                raise ValueError('installed ship manifest differs from the checked export')
            if any(managed(path.name) and path.name not in files for path in live.iterdir()):
                raise ValueError('obsolete export files remain in the ship folder')

        changes = []
        try:
            previous_ship = replaced / code if live.exists() else None
            if previous_ship:
                os.replace(live, previous_ship)
            changes.append((live, previous_ship, code))

            previous_scene = replaced / 'ship.scn' if scene.exists() else None
            if previous_scene:
                os.replace(scene, previous_scene)
            changes.append((scene, previous_scene, 'ship.scn'))
            changes.append((gen_manifest, previous_cache, 'cache_manifest.json'))
            # Only this ship is visible to the builder. Moving the old scene
            # aside forces a rebuild even when old and new stamps collide.
            refresh(incoming.parent)

            os.replace(incoming, live)

            os.replace(new_manifest, manifest)
            changes.append((manifest, previous_manifest, 'asset_manifest.json'))
            verify_install()
            readback()
            verify_install()
        except (Exception, KeyboardInterrupt):
            errors = []
            for dest, previous, name in reversed(changes):
                try:
                    if previous is not None and previous.is_file():
                        os.replace(previous, dest)
                    else:
                        if dest.exists():
                            os.replace(dest, failed / name)
                        if previous is not None:
                            os.replace(previous, dest)
                except OSError as exc:
                    errors.append(str(exc))
            if errors:
                raise RuntimeError(f'rollback incomplete. Backups at {work}: ' + ' | '.join(errors)) from None
            print(f'Install rolled back. Recovery files at {work}', file=sys.stderr)
            raise
        print(f'Installed into {live}; previous files at {replaced}')


def install_export(export, project, code, godot, job, ship, *options):
    export, project, job, ship = (Path(path).resolve() for path in (export, project, job, ship))
    if not (project / 'project.godot').is_file():
        raise ValueError(f'INSTALL_TO is not a Godot project folder: {project}')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*', code):
        raise ValueError(f'invalid ship folder code {code!r}')

    snapshot = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'stage7-checked-{code}-'))
    expected = export_snapshot(export, snapshot, code)
    for script, log, failed in (
        ('check_export.py', 'log_export_check.txt', 'CHECK FAILED'),
        ('check_export_selftest.py', 'log_export_selftest.txt', 'SELFTEST FAILED'),
    ):
        try:
            run_check([sys.executable, '-B', str(HERE / script), str(ship), str(snapshot), *options], job / log)
        except RuntimeError:
            (export / 'export_status.txt').write_text(failed + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
            raise
    verify(snapshot, expected)
    copy_verified(snapshot / (code + '_check.json'), export / (code + '_check.json'))
    with (export / 'export_status.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as status:
        status.write('CHECKED\n')

    def headless(script, args, log, marker):
        run_check([godot, '--headless', '--path', str(project), '--script', script, '--', *args], job / log, marker)

    def refresh(ships):
        headless('res://render/build_assets.gd', ['--ships-only', '--ships', ships.as_posix()],
                 'log_install_cache.txt', '[assets] ships refreshed:')

    def readback():
        headless('res://render/test/installed_ship_check.gd', [code],
                 'log_install_readback.txt', f'INSTALL READBACK PASS code={code} ')
        for line in (job / 'log_install_readback.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines():
            if line.startswith('INSTALL READBACK PASS'):
                print(line)

    install(project, code, snapshot, expected, refresh, readback)
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        args = sys.argv[1:]
        if len(args) >= 7 and args[0] == '--install':
            sys.exit(install_export(*args[1:]))
        if len(args) == 3:
            sys.exit(main(*args))
        sys.exit('usage: manifest_merge.py ENTRY PROJECT CODE or --install EXPORT PROJECT CODE GODOT JOB SHIP_JSON [unbaked=1]')
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        sys.exit(f'Stage 7 FAILED: {exc}')

@echo off
rem Issue 1174: the one shared ship build job. Every helper's ship run is a three-line wrapper that sets the inputs and calls
rem this file (docs/ship_pipeline/ship_job/README.md). Built from issue 1157's S10_RUN_1157.bat, the best guarded job of Nov 19.
rem
rem Inputs (environment, set by the wrapper):
rem   SHIP        the recipe ship id, the file name in tools\recipe\ships without .json (voidsworn_S10)
rem   CODE        the game folder the install writes (V16_37)
rem   BRANCH      the branch to build (opus/issue-1157)
rem   JOB_DIR     this job's own folder under Downloads\voidsworn_test (opus1157)
rem   STAGES      optional: the recipe stages, in order (default 1_concept_in to 7_export, all seven)
rem   SETS        optional: the a4_shots sets (default battle,close)
rem   FACS        optional: the a4_shots faction (default the part of SHIP before its first underscore)
rem   PAINT_BASE  optional: a branch merged in after the checkout; the pictures are then a labelled PREVIEW of that stack
rem   PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS  optional: how long each GPU step waits for its claim (default 3600, the most gpu_slots.js
rem               allows; the old 300 s default failed 1155, 1157 and 1158 on Nov 19 when several helpers queued at once)
rem
rem What it does, in order. Any failure skips every later step, the checks and the shots (the recipe folder is still copied
rem back, step 7, for the logs), and the last two lines of out\result.txt are always "done PASS" or "done FAILED: <step>" and then "all done".
rem   1. runs from its own copy in JOB_DIR (cmd reads a .bat as it goes, so a checkout must never rewrite the running file)
rem   2. its own clone JOB_DIR\repo (depth 50), the branch checked out (install files restored after a
rem      saved diff, never a forced checkout; any other local change or file collision stops the job), PAINT_BASE merged if set, a commit= line
rem   3. the headless import, then each stage logged with its exit code (stage 7 installs into the clone's own godot folder,
rem      never into Ryan's game)
rem   4. the installed glb must be this run's (written after the run started), else the install counts as failed
rem   5. the GPU readback, the authored interiors check and the death seam check on the installed glb; all three must pass
rem   6. the in-game shots at camera 170 and 60, only when everything above passed
rem   7. the recipe folder copied (never moved) into out\recipe
rem Writes only under voidsworn_test\JOB_DIR and voidsworn_test\recipe\SHIP (the stages' own folder). Deletes nothing: an earlier
rem run's out folder is renamed out_before_<time>, never removed.
if "%~1"=="ship" goto ship

if defined MISSING (
  echo ship_job.bat: set %MISSING% first. See docs\ship_pipeline\ship_job\README.md for the three-line wrapper.
  exit /b 2
)
set "J=%V%\%JOB_DIR%"
if not exist "%J%" mkdir "%J%"
rem 1. run from this job's own copy
if /i not "%~f0"=="%J%\ship_job_running.bat" (
  copy /y "%~f0" "%J%\ship_job_running.bat" > nul
  call "%J%\ship_job_running.bat"
  exit /b
)
if not defined STAGES set "STAGES=1_concept_in 2_shape_ref 3_trace_hull 4_parts_kit 5_paint_bake 6_lod 7_export"
if not defined SETS set "SETS=battle,close"
if not defined FACS for /f "delims=_" %%F in ("%SHIP%") do set "FACS=%%F"
if not defined PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS set PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS=3600
if not defined PC_GPU_ISSUE set "PC_GPU_ISSUE=%JOB_DIR%"
set "C=%J%\repo"
set "O=%J%\out"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%T in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"`) do set "STAMP=%%T"
if exist "%O%" ren "%O%" "out_before_%STAMP%"
mkdir "%O%"
set "RES=%O%\result.txt"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%T in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "[DateTime]::UtcNow.Ticks"`) do set "START_TICKS=%%T"
echo start %SHIP% %CODE% %BRANCH% %DATE% %TIME% > "%RES%"
echo inputs STAGES=%STAGES% SETS=%SETS% FACS=%FACS% PAINT_BASE=%PAINT_BASE% PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS=%PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS% >> "%RES%"
if exist "%J%\out_before_%STAMP%" echo the earlier run's out folder is now out_before_%STAMP% >> "%RES%"
set FAILED=

if errorlevel 1 set "FAILED=fetch %BRANCH%"
if defined FAILED goto collect
rem the checkout, in this job's own clone: stage 7 rewrites the tracked godot\assets\ships files here (manifest.json, the CODE
rem folder), and a plain checkout then refuses every rerun after the branch moved. So: list and save every tracked change
rem (clone_changes_before_checkout.txt and .patch); stop on a tracked change anywhere else (a hand fix in the clone); restore
rem only godot\assets\ships from the clone's own commit; then a plain checkout, never forced, that also refuses to overwrite
rem untracked or ignored files, so a local file the branch now tracks stops the job instead of being replaced (Artoo, PR 1179).
git -C "%C%" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no > "%O%\clone_changes_before_checkout.txt" 2> "%O%\log_clone_status.txt"
if errorlevel 1 set "FAILED=checkout: could not save the clone's change list or patch, nothing was reset"
if defined FAILED goto collect
git -C "%C%" diff --binary HEAD > "%O%\clone_changes_before_checkout.patch" 2>> "%O%\log_clone_status.txt"
if errorlevel 1 set "FAILED=checkout: could not save the clone's change list or patch, nothing was reset"
if defined FAILED goto collect
rem git filters the list itself (findstr $ needs a CR and git writes LF only; Fable on PR 1190)
git -C "%C%" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no -- . ":(exclude)godot/assets/ships" ":(glob,exclude)godot/**/*.import" > "%O%\clone_changes_unexpected.txt" 2>> "%O%\log_clone_status.txt"
if errorlevel 1 set "FAILED=checkout: git status of the clone failed, nothing was reset"
if defined FAILED goto collect

if errorlevel 1 set "FAILED=checkout: could not restore godot\assets\ships in the clone"

rem files); they are saved in the patch above and restored from the clone's own commit like the install files
git -C "%C%" checkout -q HEAD -- ":(glob)godot/**/*.import" >> "%RES%" 2>&1

git -C "%C%" checkout -q --no-overwrite-ignore -B shipjob FETCH_HEAD >> "%RES%" 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 set "FAILED=checkout %BRANCH%"
if defined FAILED goto collect

git -C "%C%" fetch -q --depth 50 origin %PAINT_BASE% >> "%RES%" 2>&1

echo merged %PAINT_BASE%: the pictures of this run are a PREVIEW of that paint stack >> "%RES%"
:based
git -C "%C%" log -1 --format=commit=%%H >> "%RES%" 2>&1

rem 3. import, then the stages, each in a fresh cmd so the variables the stages set end with them
cd /d "%C%"
call "%C%\tools\pc\tmo.bat" 21600 "%GD%" --headless --path "%C%\godot" --import > "%O%\log_import.txt" 2>&1
set EL=%ERRORLEVEL%
echo import exit %EL% >> "%RES%"
if not "%EL%"=="0" set "FAILED=import"
if defined FAILED goto collect

 succeeded in 133ms:
}
# Restart Manager can name file holders without installing handle.exe. It cannot report directory-only handles,
# and access may be denied in a sandbox; diagnostics must never prevent the preservation retry.
function Get-RepoHolders($full) {
  try {
    if (-not ('RunnerFileHolders' -as [type])) {
      Add-Type -TypeDefinition @'
using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
public static class RunnerFileHolders {
  [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct UniqueProcess {
    public uint id; public System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes.FILETIME started;
  }
  [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] public struct Info {
    public UniqueProcess process;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 256)] public string name;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 64)] public string service;
    public uint type, status, session;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] public bool restartable;
  }
  [DllImport("rstrtmgr.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] static extern int RmStartSession(out uint session, uint flags, StringBuilder key);
  [DllImport("rstrtmgr.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] static extern int RmRegisterResources(uint session, uint files, string[] names, uint apps, IntPtr processes, uint services, IntPtr serviceNames);
  [DllImport("rstrtmgr.dll")] static extern int RmGetList(uint session, out uint needed, ref uint count, [In, Out] Info[] info, ref uint reasons);
  [DllImport("rstrtmgr.dll")] static extern int RmEndSession(uint session);
  public static Info[] Find(string[] paths) {
    uint session; int error = RmStartSession(out session, 0, new StringBuilder(33));
    if (error != 0) throw new Win32Exception(error);
    try {
      error = RmRegisterResources(session, (uint)paths.Length, paths, 0, IntPtr.Zero, 0, IntPtr.Zero);
      if (error != 0) throw new Win32Exception(error);
      uint needed, count = 0, reasons = 0;
      var info = new Info[0];
      for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt++) {
        error = RmGetList(session, out needed, ref count, info, ref reasons);
        if (error == 0) { Array.Resize(ref info, (int)count); return info; }
        if (error != 234) throw new Win32Exception(error);
        count = needed; info = new Info[count];
      }
      throw new Win32Exception(error);
    } finally { RmEndSession(session); }
  }
}
'@
    }
    # Register files, not the directory: RmGetList rejects directories with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED.
    $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $full -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })
    $gitDir = Join-Path $full '.git'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gitDir -PathType Container) {
      $files += @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $gitDir -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })
    }
    $holders = @(); if ($files.Count) { $holders = @([RunnerFileHolders]::Find([string[]]$files)) }
    foreach ($holder in $holders) { Log "Windows file holder: PID $($holder.process.id) $($holder.name)" }
  } catch { Log "Windows file holder lookup unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
  try {
    # Command lines are useful for an agent holding only its current directory. These are candidates, not proof.
    $candidates = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.IndexOf($full, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 })
    foreach ($holder in $candidates) { Log "possible checkout holder: PID $($holder.ProcessId) $($holder.Name): $($holder.CommandLine)" }
    if (-not $holders.Count -and -not $candidates.Count) { Log 'Windows could not name the checkout holder (directory handles may not be reported)' }
  } catch { Log "Windows holder lookup unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
}
function Keep-Repo($repo, $tag) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $repo)) { return }
  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($repo).TrimEnd('\')
  if ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($full) -ne 'repo') { throw "refusing to rename unexpected checkout path $full" }
  $name = "repo-$tag-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
  $limit = 600.0; $pause = 1000
  if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_KEEP_SECONDS) { $limit = [double]$env:PC_TEST_KEEP_SECONDS }
  if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_KEEP_POLL_MS) { $pause = [int]$env:PC_TEST_KEEP_POLL_MS }
  $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); $nextLog = 0.0
  while ($true) {
    try { Rename-Item -LiteralPath $full -NewName $name -ErrorAction Stop; break }
    catch {
      $failure = $_.Exception.Message
      if ($clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds -ge $nextLog) {
        Log "checkout rename held; waiting up to $limit seconds: $full : $failure"
        Get-RepoHolders $full
        $nextLog = $clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds + 60
      }
      $left = $limit - $clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds
      if ($left -le 0) { throw "checkout rename still held after $limit seconds; earlier checkout kept at ${full}: $failure" }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds ([int][Math]::Min($pause, [Math]::Ceiling($left * 1000)))
    }
  }
  if ($tag -eq 'kept') {
    try {
      # Renaming a checkout can preserve its old timestamp. Date the kept copy at preservation time.
      $kept = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $full) $name) -Force
      if (-not ($kept.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { $kept.LastWriteTimeUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow }
    } catch { Log "WARNING: could not date kept checkout ${name}: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
  }
  Log "earlier checkout kept beside repo as $name"
}
function Warn-KeptRepos($repo) {
  $board = Split-Path -Parent ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($repo))
  try { $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' }) }
  catch { Log "WARNING: kept checkout sizes unavailable in ${board}: $($_.Exception.Message)"; return }
  if ($copies.Count -le 2) { return }
  Log "WARNING: $board has $($copies.Count) repo-kept-* copies; left in place during checkout"
  foreach ($copy in $copies) {
    try {
      if ($copy.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'linked checkout; total unavailable' }
      $bytes = 0L; $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[string]'; $pending.Push($copy.FullName)
      while ($pending.Count) {
        foreach ($item in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $pending.Pop() -Force -ErrorAction Stop)) {
          if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'size excludes a linked path; total unavailable' }
          if ($item.PSIsContainer) { $pending.Push($item.FullName) } else { $bytes += $item.Length }
        }
      }
      Log "WARNING: kept checkout $($copy.FullName): $bytes logical bytes ($([Math]::Round($bytes / 1GB, 3)) GiB)"
    } catch { Log "WARNING: kept checkout $($copy.FullName): size unavailable ($($_.Exception.Message))" }
  }
}
function Test-SharedShipCopy($repo, $path) {
  # Use the same default shared build as get_ship_files.bat.
  $build = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads/voidsworn_test/build'
  $local = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo $path) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $shared = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $build $path) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  foreach ($file in @($local, $shared)) {
    if ($file -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($file.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { return $false }
  }
  if ($local.Length -ne $shared.Length) { return $false }
  # Git can list the contents of a junction as ignored files. Keep checkouts that contain a linked ship directory.
  $root = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($repo).TrimEnd('\','/')
  for ($dir = $local.Directory; $dir -and $dir.FullName -ne $root; $dir = $dir.Parent) {
    if ($dir.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { return $false }
  }
  return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $local.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -eq
         (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $shared.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
}
function Reuse-Caches($repo) {
  $status = @(Git @('--no-optional-locks','-C',$repo,'-c','core.quotePath=false','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all','--ignored','--ignore-submodules=none'))
  if ($gitExit -ne 0) {
    $detail = $status | Select-Object -First 1
    throw "working tree status not verified (Git exit ${gitExit}: $detail)"
  }
  foreach ($line in $status) {
    # Match ignored files only. A nested repository can show up as an ignored directory with a trailing slash.
    if ($line -match '^!! (godot/(?:\.godot/[^"\\:\r\n]+|[^"\\:\r\n]+\.import)|(?:[^"\\:\r\n]*/)?__pycache__/[^"\\:\r\n]+|[^"\\:\r\n]+\.pyc)(?<!/)$') {
      $Matches[1]
      continue
    }
    if ($line -match '^!! ("?)(godot/(?:gen/[^"\\:\r\n]+|[^"\\:\r\n]+\.uid|(?:campaign|rules)/test/(?:golden|out)/[^"\\:\r\n]+|campaign/test/parity_campaign_log\.txt|rules/test/parity_log\.txt)|\.onboarding_checks/[^"\\:\r\n]+)(?<!/)\1$') {
      $Matches[2]
      continue
    }
    # Git can quote paths with spaces. Leave paths with escapes or unknown status alone.
    if ($line -match '^!! ("?)(godot/assets/ships/[^"\\:\r\n]+)\1$') {
      $path = $Matches[2]
      if (-not (Test-SharedShipCopy $repo $path)) { throw "working tree needs keeping: $line (shared ship copy could not be verified)" }
      $path
      continue
    }
    throw "working tree needs keeping: $line"
  }
}
function Get-RebuildableRepoFiles($repo, $mirror, $sparse) {
  if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $repo -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'checkout is a linked path' }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo '.git') -PathType Container)) { throw 'not a standalone checkout' }
  $top = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','--show-toplevel'))
  if ($gitExit -ne 0 -or [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($top[0]) -ne [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($repo)) { throw 'checkout root not verified' }
  # Changing sparse patterns can discard ignored files. Preserve these checkouts instead.
  $oldSparse = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'config','--bool','core.sparseCheckout'))
  if ($gitExit -notin @(0,1)) { throw 'sparse checkout setting not verified' }
  if ($sparse -or ($oldSparse.Count -and $oldSparse[0] -eq 'true')) { throw 'sparse checkout needs keeping' }
  $shallow = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository'))
  if ($gitExit -ne 0 -or $shallow[0] -ne 'false') { throw 'complete local history not verified' }
  $flags = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'ls-files','-v'))
  if ($gitExit -ne 0 -or @($flags | Where-Object { $_ -cmatch '^[a-zS] ' }).Count) { throw 'index may hide tracked edits' }
  $caches = @(Reuse-Caches $repo)
  $local = @(Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-list','--all','--reflog','HEAD'))
  if ($gitExit -ne 0 -or -not $local.Count) { throw 'local history not verified' }
  $remote = @(Git @('--git-dir',$mirror,'rev-list','--all'))
  if ($gitExit -ne 0 -or -not $remote.Count) { throw 'fetched history not verified' }
  $pushed = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]'
  foreach ($id in $remote) { $null = $pushed.Add($id) }
  foreach ($id in $local) { if (-not $pushed.Contains($id)) { throw "local history not in fetched mirror: $id" } }
  return $caches
}
function Can-ReuseRepo($repo, $mirror, $sparse) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $repo)) { return $false }
  try {
    $caches = @(Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $repo $mirror $sparse)
    # Keep the whole checkout when an ignored file obstructs the incoming tree.
    $paths = @(Git @('--git-dir',$mirror,'-c','core.quotePath=false','ls-tree','-r','--name-only','refs/heads/main'))
    if ($gitExit -ne 0) { throw 'incoming paths not verified' }
    $files = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' ([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    $dirs = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]' ([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    foreach ($path in $paths) {
      $null = $files.Add($path); $parent = $path
      while ($parent.Contains('/')) { $parent = $parent.Substring(0, $parent.LastIndexOf('/')); $null = $dirs.Add($parent) }
    }
    foreach ($cache in $caches) {
      $path = $cache.TrimEnd('/')
      if ($dirs.Contains($path)) { throw "cache would obstruct incoming directory: $cache" }
      while ($path) {
        if ($files.Contains($path)) { throw "cache would be overwritten by incoming file: $cache" }
        if (-not $path.Contains('/')) { break }; $path = $path.Substring(0, $path.LastIndexOf('/'))
      }
    }
    return $true
  } catch { Log "checkout needs keeping: $($_.Exception.Message)"; return $false }
}
function Repo-Mirror {
  if ($test) { return $env:PC_TEST_MIRROR }
  Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\voidsworn_test\repo-mirror.git'
}
function Cleanup-Paused {
  if (-not $env:USERPROFILE) { return $false }
  $flag = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\voidsworn_test\gpu_go.txt'
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $flag)) { return $false }
  return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $flag -TotalCount 1) -match '^GPU not cleared: paused by the Board\b'
}
function Assert-PlainDirectory($directory) {
  for ($dir = $directory; $dir; $dir = $dir.Parent) {
    if ($dir -isnot [IO.DirectoryInfo] -or ($dir.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) {
      throw "directory is missing or linked: $($dir.FullName)"
    }
  }
}
function Assert-NoLinkedChildren($directory) {
  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[string]'
  $pending.Push($directory)
  while ($pending.Count) {
    foreach ($item in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $pending.Pop() -Force -ErrorAction Stop)) {
      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
      if ($item.PSIsContainer) { $pending.Push($item.FullName) }
    }
  }
}
function Read-ScratchOwner($directory) {
  $owner = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $directory $scratchOwnerFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if (-not $owner) { throw 'ownership token file is missing' }
  if ($owner -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($owner.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -or $owner.Length -ne 32) {
    throw 'ownership token file changed'
  }
  $token = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($owner.FullName)
  if ($token -cnotmatch '\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z') { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
  return $token
}
function Get-OwnedScratch($record, $expected) {
  $temp = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:PC_RUN_TEMP).TrimEnd('\','/')
  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($record.path)
  if ($full -ne $record.path -or $full -ne $expected -or (Split-Path -Parent $full) -ne $temp -or
      (Split-Path -Leaf $full) -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-(?:[1-9][0-9]*-)?[0-9a-f]{32}$') {
    throw 'recorded path does not match this run and its TEMP directory'
  }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { return }
  $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $full -Force
  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
  if ((Read-ScratchOwner $full) -cne $record.token) { throw 'ownership token file changed' }
  # Linux filesystems do not always expose a stable directory birth time.
  if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT -and
      [string]$dir.CreationTimeUtc.Ticks -ne $record.created) { throw 'recorded directory was replaced' }
  return $dir
}
function Remove-CleanupDirectory($dir) {
  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Force)
  if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir.FullName) { throw 'directory could not be fully removed' }
}
function Complete-RunScratch($record, $keepFailed) {
  if (-not $record) { return }
  try {
    $dir = Get-OwnedScratch $record $env:PC_RUN_SCRATCH
    if (-not $dir) { return }
    if (-not $keepFailed) {
      Assert-NoLinkedChildren $dir.FullName
      Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir
      Log "run scratch removed: $($dir.FullName)"
      return
    }
    if ($dir.Name -notmatch '^voidsworn-run-([1-9][0-9]*)-[0-9a-f]{32}$') { return }
    $issue = $Matches[1]
    # Only the runner holding the issue across this run can replace its retry scratch.
    if ($env:PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE -ne $issue) { throw 'run does not hold the issue lock' }
    $marker = Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker) { return }
    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
    $file = [IO.File]::Open($marker, 'CreateNew', 'Write', 'None')
    $file.Dispose()
    Log "run scratch kept for a retry for one day: $($dir.FullName)"
    foreach ($old in $dir.Parent.GetDirectories("voidsworn-run-$issue-*")) {
      if ($old.FullName -eq $dir.FullName -or $old.Name -notmatch "^voidsworn-run-$issue-[0-9a-f]{32}$") { continue }
      try {
        Assert-PlainDirectory $old
        if (-not (Get-FailedScratchMarker $old)) { continue }
        $null = Read-ScratchOwner $old.FullName
        Assert-NoLinkedChildren $old.FullName
        Remove-CleanupDirectory $old
        Log "older failed run scratch removed: $($old.FullName)"
      } catch { Log "older failed run scratch kept: $($old.FullName) ($($_.Exception.Message))" }
    }
  } catch { Log "run scratch kept: $($record.path) ($($_.Exception.Message))" }
}
function Get-FailedScratchMarker($dir) {
  $marker = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir.FullName $scratchFailedFile) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($marker -and ($marker -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($marker.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
    throw 'retry marker is not a plain file'
  }
  return $marker
}
function Measure-CleanupDirectory($directory) {
  Assert-PlainDirectory $directory
  $bytes = 0L; $latest = $directory.LastWriteTimeUtc
  $pending = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.Stack[IO.DirectoryInfo]'
  $pending.Push($directory)
  while ($pending.Count) {
    foreach ($item in $pending.Pop().EnumerateFileSystemInfos()) {
      if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw "linked path: $($item.FullName)" }
      if ($item -is [IO.DirectoryInfo]) { $pending.Push($item); continue }
      $bytes += $item.Length
      if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $latest) { $latest = $item.LastWriteTimeUtc }
    }
  }
  return [pscustomobject]@{ Bytes = $bytes; Latest = $latest }
}
function Open-CleanupLock($path, $existingOnly = $false) {
  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($item -and ($item -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) {
    throw "lock is not a plain file: $path"
  }
  if ($existingOnly -and -not $item) { return }
  if ($existingOnly) { return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'Open', 'Read', 'None') }
  return [IO.File]::Open($path, 'OpenOrCreate', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
}
function Remove-OlderKeptRepos($board, $mirror, $dryRun = $false) {
  Assert-PlainDirectory (Get-Item -LiteralPath $board -Force)
  $lock = $null
  try { $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Join-Path $board 'repo.cleanup.lock') $dryRun } catch { Log "kept checkout scan kept: $board ($($_.Exception.Message))"; return }
  try {
    $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $board -Directory -Force |
      Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'repo-kept-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc, CreationTimeUtc, Name -Descending)
    foreach ($copy in $copies) {
      $size = 'size unavailable'
      try {
        $candidate = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($copy.FullName)
        if ((Split-Path -Parent $candidate) -ne $board) { throw 'outside the board directory' }
        $stats = Measure-CleanupDirectory $copy
        $size = "$($stats.Bytes) bytes"
        if ($copy -eq $copies[0]) { Log "kept checkout retained (newest): $candidate ($size)"; continue }
        $gitDir = Join-Path $candidate '.git'
        foreach ($state in @('index.lock','MERGE_HEAD','CHERRY_PICK_HEAD','REVERT_HEAD','BISECT_START','rebase-apply','rebase-merge','sequencer','modules','worktrees')) {
          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $gitDir $state)) { throw "Git holds local state: $state" }
        }
        $null = Get-RebuildableRepoFiles $candidate $mirror ''
        if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
        if ($dryRun) { Log "kept checkout would remove (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)" }
        else {
          Remove-CleanupDirectory $copy
          Log "kept checkout removed (rebuildable): $candidate ($size)"
        }
      } catch { Log "kept checkout retained: $($copy.FullName) ($size; $($_.Exception.Message))" }
    }
  } finally { if ($lock) { $lock.Dispose() } }
}
# Windows command line quoting, including trailing backslashes. Inputs are argument values, never shell snippets.
function Quote($value) { return '"' + ([regex]::Replace(([string]$value), '(\\*)"', '$1$1\"') -replace '(\\+)$', '$1$1') + '"' }
# Final reporting is best effort. Start validation and claiming must fail closed.
function Invoke-Gh($method, $endpoint, $payload = $null, $pages = $false) {
  $script:ghOK = $false
  $script:ghError = ''
  try {
    $exe = 'gh'
    if ($test) {
      if (-not $env:PC_TEST_GH) { Log 'GitHub status skipped: test has no fake gh'; return '' }
      $exe = $env:PC_TEST_GH
    }
    $command = Get-Command $exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $command -and -not $test) {
      # Chain windows opened before installation still have the old PATH.
      foreach ($install in @(
        @{ root = $env:ProgramFiles; relative = 'GitHub CLI/gh.exe' },
        @{ root = $env:LOCALAPPDATA; relative = 'Programs/GitHub CLI/gh.exe' }
      )) {
        if (-not $install.root) { continue }
        $candidate = Join-Path $install.root $install.relative
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Leaf) {
          $exe = $candidate
          $command = Get-Command $exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($command) { break }
        }
      }
    }
    if (-not $command -and $script:boardReadOnly -and -not $test -and $method -eq 'GET') {
      # The public board audit works before gh is installed. Claims always require authenticated gh.
      if (-not $script:ghMissingLogged) {
        Log 'GitHub CLI gh is missing: claims will fail closed; this read-only audit uses public REST'
        $script:ghMissingLogged = $true
      }
      $items = @(); $page = 1
      do {
        $url = "https://api.github.com/repos/rcbailey12/voidsworn/$endpoint"
        if ($pages) { $url += "&page=$page" }
        $reply = Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'voidsworn-runner-board-audit' } -Uri $url
        if (-not $pages) { $script:ghOK = $true; return (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $reply -Depth 30) }
        $items += @($reply); $page++
      } while (@($reply).Count -eq 100)
      $script:ghOK = $true
      return ('[' + (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($items) -Depth 30 -Compress) + ']')
    }
    if (-not $command) { throw 'GitHub CLI gh is missing; install it and run gh auth login before starting PC jobs' }
    if ($command.CommandType -eq 'Application') { $exe = $command.Source }
    if ($script:ghExeLogged -ne $exe) { Log "GitHub CLI: $exe"; $script:ghExeLogged = $exe }
    $words = @('api','--method',$method,"repos/rcbailey12/voidsworn/$endpoint")
    if ($pages) { $words += @('--paginate','--slurp') }
    if ($null -ne $payload) {
      $file = Join-Path $out 'github_payload.json'
      Put $file ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8)
      $words += @('--input',$file)
    }
    $ea = $ErrorActionPreference
    try {
      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
      $lines = @(& $exe @words 2>&1); $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $ea }
    if ($code -ne 0) { throw "exit $code $($lines -join ' ')" }
    $script:ghOK = $true
    return ($lines -join "`n")
  } catch { $script:ghError = $_.Exception.Message; Log "WARNING: GitHub status $method $endpoint failed: $script:ghError"; return '' }
}

  return @"

- Run: $($s.run)
- Lane: $($g.lane)

function write(file, value) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, value);
}
function read(file) { return fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); }
function execute(exe, args, input, extra = {}) {
  const r = spawnSync(exe, args, { input, cwd: root, env: { ...env, ...extra }, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, timeout: 30000 });
  if (r.error) throw r.error;
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, `${exe} ${args.join(' ')}: ${r.stdout}\n${r.stderr}`);
  return r.stdout.trim();
}
const git = (args, input) => execute('git', args, input);
function shared(args, scratch = '', issue = '') {
  const scratchEnv = scratch ? { TEMP: scratch, TMP: scratch, TMPDIR: scratch } : {};

}

}
function finish(run, { code = '0', partial = '', push = 'real', checks = '1', confirmed = true, selected = run.scratch, checkout = '' } = {}) {
  write(path.join(run.out, 'run_commit.txt'), 'a'.repeat(40));
  if (confirmed) write(path.join(run.out, 'confirmed_commit.txt'), 'a'.repeat(40));
  shared(['finish', run.out, code, partial, push, checks, checkout], selected, run.issue);
  return read(path.join(run.out, 'result.txt'));
}

function makeCopy(name, age, lane = board) {
  const dir = path.join(lane, name);
  git(['clone', '-q', '-c', 'core.autocrlf=false', mirror, dir]);

}
function dated(file, hours) {
  const time = new Date(Date.now() - hours * 3600000);
  fs.utimesSync(file, time, time);
}

function Invoke-Gh($method, $endpoint, $payload = $null, $pages = $false) {
  $script:ghOK = $false
  $script:ghError = ''
  try {
    $exe = 'gh'
    if ($test) {
      if (-not $env:PC_TEST_GH) { Log 'GitHub status skipped: test has no fake gh'; return '' }
      $exe = $env:PC_TEST_GH
    }
    $command = Get-Command $exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $command -and -not $test) {
      # Chain windows opened before installation still have the old PATH.
      foreach ($install in @(
        @{ root = $env:ProgramFiles; relative = 'GitHub CLI/gh.exe' },
        @{ root = $env:LOCALAPPDATA; relative = 'Programs/GitHub CLI/gh.exe' }
      )) {
        if (-not $install.root) { continue }
        $candidate = Join-Path $install.root $install.relative
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Leaf) {
          $exe = $candidate
          $command = Get-Command $exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($command) { break }
        }
      }
    }
    if (-not $command -and $script:boardReadOnly -and -not $test -and $method -eq 'GET') {
      # The public board audit works before gh is installed. Claims always require authenticated gh.
      if (-not $script:ghMissingLogged) {
        Log 'GitHub CLI gh is missing: claims will fail closed; this read-only audit uses public REST'
        $script:ghMissingLogged = $true
      }
      $items = @(); $page = 1
      do {
        $url = "https://api.github.com/repos/rcbailey12/voidsworn/$endpoint"
        if ($pages) { $url += "&page=$page" }
        $reply = Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'voidsworn-runner-board-audit' } -Uri $url
        if (-not $pages) { $script:ghOK = $true; return (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $reply -Depth 30) }
        $items += @($reply); $page++
      } while (@($reply).Count -eq 100)
      $script:ghOK = $true
      return ('[' + (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($items) -Depth 30 -Compress) + ']')
    }
    if (-not $command) { throw 'GitHub CLI gh is missing; install it and run gh auth login before starting PC jobs' }
    if ($command.CommandType -eq 'Application') { $exe = $command.Source }
    if ($script:ghExeLogged -ne $exe) { Log "GitHub CLI: $exe"; $script:ghExeLogged = $exe }
    $words = @('api','--method',$method,"repos/rcbailey12/voidsworn/$endpoint")
    if ($pages) { $words += @('--paginate','--slurp') }
    if ($null -ne $payload) {
      $file = Join-Path $out 'github_payload.json'
      Put $file ($payload | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8)
      $words += @('--input',$file)
    }
    $ea = $ErrorActionPreference
    try {
      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
      $lines = @(& $exe @words 2>&1); $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $ea }
    if ($code -ne 0) { throw "exit $code $($lines -join ' ')" }
    $script:ghOK = $true
    return ($lines -join "`n")
  } catch { $script:ghError = $_.Exception.Message; Log "WARNING: GitHub status $method $endpoint failed: $script:ghError"; return '' }
}

}

"""Fault checks for stage 7. All writes go to a temporary project."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tempfile
from unittest.mock import patch

import manifest_merge as stage


CODE = 'TEST_1101'
GLB = CODE + '.glb'
JPG = CODE + '_base.jpg'
OLD_MAP = CODE + '_old.jpg'


def check_snapshot(root):
    export, snapshot = root / 'export', root / 'checked'
    export.mkdir(parents=True)
    snapshot.mkdir()
    doc = json.dumps({'images': [{'uri': JPG}]}).encode('utf-8')
    doc += b' ' * (-len(doc) % 4)
    glb = struct.pack('<4sIII4s', b'glTF', 2, 20 + len(doc), len(doc), b'JSON') + doc
    (export / GLB).write_bytes(glb)
    (export / JPG).write_bytes(b'checked texture')
    (export / OLD_MAP).write_bytes(b'left over from a previous export')
    (export / stage.ENTRY).write_bytes(b'{}')
    expected = stage.export_snapshot(export, snapshot, CODE)
    assert set(expected) == {GLB, JPG, stage.ENTRY}
    assert {path.name for path in snapshot.iterdir()} == set(expected)
    stage.verify(snapshot, expected)
    print('PASS exact export set')


def setup(root):
    snapshot = root / 'checked'
    snapshot.mkdir(parents=True)
    (snapshot / GLB).write_bytes(b'checked hull')
    (snapshot / JPG).write_bytes(b'checked texture')
    (snapshot / stage.ENTRY).write_text('{"hardpoints":{"core":1}}', encoding='utf-8')
    expected = {path.name: stage.sha256(path) for path in snapshot.iterdir()}

    project = root / 'project with spaces'
    live = project / 'assets' / 'ships' / CODE
    scene = project / 'gen' / 'ships' / (CODE + '.scn')
    live.mkdir(parents=True)
    scene.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    originals = {live / GLB: b'old hull', live / JPG: b'old texture',
                 live / OLD_MAP: b'old map', live / (CODE + '_wreck.glb'): b'old wreck',
                 live / (CODE + '_damage.glb'): b'old damage', live / 'notes.txt': b'keep',
                 live.parent / 'manifest.json': b'{"ships":{"other":{"keep":true}}}',
                 scene: b'old cached scene', scene.parent.parent / 'manifest.json': b'old cache manifest'}
    for path, data in originals.items():
        path.write_bytes(data)
    (project / 'project.godot').touch()
    return project, live, scene, snapshot, expected, originals


def exercise(root, fault):
    project, live, scene, snapshot, expected, originals = setup(root)
    manifest = live.parent / 'manifest.json'
    cache = scene.parent.parent / 'manifest.json'
    refreshed = False

    def refresh(ships):
        nonlocal refreshed
        refreshed = True
        assert [child.name for child in ships.iterdir()] == [CODE]
        assert (ships / CODE / GLB).read_bytes() == b'checked hull'
        assert not scene.exists(), 'the old cache scene could suppress a rebuild'
        # A second stage or manifest-only merge cannot write inside this window.
        try:
            stage.main(snapshot / stage.ENTRY, project, 'another_ship')
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            assert 'another ship install' in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('a second installer acquired the project lock')
        scene.write_bytes(b'new cached scene')
        cache.write_bytes(b'new cache manifest')
        if fault == 'refresh':
            raise RuntimeError('injected refresh failure')

    def readback():
        assert scene.read_bytes() == b'new cached scene'
        assert (live / GLB).read_bytes() == b'checked hull'
        assert (live / JPG).read_bytes() == b'checked texture'
        assert (live / 'notes.txt').read_bytes() == b'keep'
        assert set(path.name for path in live.iterdir()) == {GLB, JPG, 'notes.txt'}
        assert json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())['ships'] == {
            'other': {'keep': True}, CODE: {'hardpoints': {'core': 1}}}
        if fault == 'readback':
            raise RuntimeError('injected readback failure')
        if fault == 'changed_installed_map':
            (live / JPG).write_bytes(b'wrong installed texture')

    real_copy = stage.shutil.copy2
    real_replace = stage.os.replace
    manifest_publishes = 0

    def copy(source, target, *args, **kwargs):
        if (fault == 'backup_copy' and source == cache) or (fault == 'stage_copy' and source == snapshot / JPG):
            raise PermissionError('injected copy failure')
        return real_copy(source, target, *args, **kwargs)

    def replace(src, dest):
        nonlocal manifest_publishes
        if fault == 'backup_move' and src == scene:
            raise PermissionError('injected backup move failure')
        if dest == manifest and src.name == 'manifest.json':
            manifest_publishes += 1
            assert manifest.read_bytes() == originals[manifest]
        return real_replace(src, dest)

    if fault == 'changed_checked_glb':
        (snapshot / GLB).write_bytes(b'changed checked hull')

    with patch.object(stage.shutil, 'copy2', copy), patch.object(stage.os, 'replace', replace):
        try:
            stage.install(project, CODE, snapshot, expected, refresh, readback)
        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
            assert fault is not None, exc
            assert 'injected' in str(exc) or 'differs from the checked export' in str(exc), exc
        else:
            assert fault is None, f'{fault} was accepted'

    if fault:
        assert all(path.read_bytes() == data for path, data in originals.items()), 'the previous install changed'
        assert refreshed == (fault in ('refresh', 'readback', 'changed_installed_map'))
    else:
        readback()
        assert manifest_publishes == 1
        backup = next(project.glob('.stage7-replaced-*')) / 'previous'
        assert (backup / CODE / GLB).read_bytes() == originals[live / GLB]
        assert (backup / 'asset_manifest.json').read_bytes() == originals[manifest]
        assert (backup / 'ship.scn').read_bytes() == originals[scene]
    # The lock also releases on a failed transaction.
    with stage.project_lock(project):
        pass
    print(f'PASS {fault or "install"}')

function Runner-Temp {
  if ($env:PC_RUN_TEMP) { return $env:PC_RUN_TEMP }
  return [IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
}
function Issue-LockPath($issue, $temp = (Runner-Temp)) {
  if ($issue -notmatch '\A[1-9][0-9]*\z') { throw 'invalid job issue number; no agent started' }
  if ($test -and $env:PC_TEST_GH_DB) { return Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $env:PC_TEST_GH_DB) "issue-$issue.lock" }
  return Join-Path $temp "voidsworn-runner-issue-$issue.lock"
}
function Issue-Lock($issue) {
  $path = Issue-LockPath $issue
  $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(30)
  while ($true) {
    try { return Open-CleanupLock $path }
    catch [IO.IOException] {
      if ([DateTime]::UtcNow -ge $deadline) { throw 'job claim stayed locked for 30 seconds; no agent started' }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    }
  }
}
function Invoke-LockedRunner($start, $issue) {
  # Keep the lock until the child finishes recording its result and cleaning its scratch.
  $lock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $issue)
  try {
    $start.EnvironmentVariables['PC_RUNNER_LOCKED_ISSUE'] = $issue
    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
    $child = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
    try {
      $stderr = $child.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
      while ($null -ne ($line = $child.StandardOutput.ReadLine())) { Write-Host $line }
      $child.WaitForExit()
      $errors = $stderr.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
      if ($errors) { [Console]::Error.Write($errors) }
      return $child.ExitCode
    }
    finally { $child.Dispose() }
  } finally { $lock.Dispose() }
}

# Issue 953: the report and the runner check logs carry PC paths. A path to a file inside this job's checkout becomes a
# GitHub link on the delivery branch, so it opens on a phone; every other path under the user's home folder becomes
# %USERPROFILE%\..., so no PC folder name reaches a public pull request. Everything else is left exactly as written.
function Path-Pattern([string]$p) {
  if (-not $p) { return '' }
  # Either separator matches, whatever the host wrote: every joined separator is [\\/]+, and a leading
  # separator (a Unix absolute path) is part of the match so none is left in front of the replacement.
  $lead = ''
  if ($p -match '^[\\/]') { $lead = '[\\/]+' }
  $segs = @($p -split '[\\/]+' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
  if (-not $segs.Count) { return '' }
  return $lead + (@($segs | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }) -join '[\\/]+')
}
function Profile-Root {
  if ($env:USERPROFILE) { return $env:USERPROFILE }
  if ($env:HOME) { return $env:HOME }
  return ''
}

'use strict';
// Issue 1174: static checks of the shared ship job, tools/pc/jobs/ship_job.bat, and of the helper wrappers that call it.
// Runs on any host (no cmd needed). What it holds:
//   the guard: after every step that can fail, "if defined FAILED goto collect" comes before the next command, so a failed
//     stage, install or check never reaches the shots; the shots line sits right behind that guard;
//   all three installed-glb checks (readback, interiors, death seam) count toward the guard (S10_RUN_1157.bat let a failed
//     death seam through to the shots);
//   the GPU wait default (3600, the gpu_slots.js MAX_WAIT_SECONDS that every ship checkout's helper accepts) is set before any GPU step;
//   the last line: every way out of the main job writes "done PASS" or "done FAILED: ..." and then "all done";
//   no delete or move commands, and output only under the job folder;
//   every wrapper in docs/ship_pipeline/ship_job/wrappers/ is three lines that set the inputs and call ship_job.bat.
const assert = require('assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');
const JOB = path.join(ROOT, 'tools/pc/jobs/ship_job.bat');
const WRAPPERS = path.join(ROOT, 'docs/ship_pipeline/ship_job/wrappers');
let passed = 0;
const pass = s => { passed++; console.log('PASS ' + s); };

const text = fs.readFileSync(JOB, 'utf8');
const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
const code = lines.map((l, i) => ({ n: i + 1, s: l.trim() })).filter(l => l.s && !/^rem\b/i.test(l.s));
const at = re => code.findIndex(l => re.test(l.s));
const main = code.slice(0, at(/^:collect$/));
const isCommand = s => /(tmo\.bat|^git |^cmd \/c|^powershell |^call |^xcopy |^copy )/i.test(s);
const guard = /^if defined FAILED goto collect$/i;
const mayFail = s => /set "?(FAILED|CHECKFAIL)=/i.test(s) && !/^set (FAILED|CHECKFAIL)=$/i.test(s);

// the guard
const shots = main.filter(l => /a4_shots\.tscn/.test(l.s));
assert.equal(shots.length, 1, 'exactly one shots command in the main job');
const before = main[main.indexOf(shots[0]) - 1];
assert(guard.test(before.s), `line ${before.n} before the shots must be the FAILED guard, is: ${before.s}`);
const firstFail = main.findIndex(l => mayFail(l.s));
assert(firstFail > 0, 'the job sets FAILED somewhere');
for (let i = firstFail; i < main.indexOf(shots[0]); i++) {
  if (!mayFail(main[i].s)) continue;
  let j = i + 1;
  while (j < main.length && !guard.test(main[j].s) && !isCommand(main[j].s)) j++;
  // a CHECKFAIL line may be followed by the next check: the checks all run, then CHECKFAIL turns into FAILED before the guard
  if (/CHECKFAIL=/.test(main[i].s) && isCommand(main[j].s) && /installed_ship_check|authored_interiors|death_seam/.test(main[j].s)) continue;
  if (/^if defined FAILED git -C .* merge --abort/.test(main[j].s)) j++;
  assert(j < main.length && guard.test(main[j].s), `line ${main[i].n} can fail, but line ${main[j] && main[j].n} runs before the guard`);
}
for (const check of ['installed_ship_check.gd', 'authored_interiors_check.gd', 'death_seam_check.gd']) {
  const k = main.findIndex(l => l.s.includes(check));
  assert(k > 0, check + ' runs');
  const tail = main.slice(k + 1, k + 5).map(l => l.s).join('\n');
  assert(/set EL=%ERRORLEVEL%/.test(tail) && /if not "%EL%"=="0" set "CHECKFAIL=/.test(tail), check + ' counts toward CHECKFAIL');
  assert(k < main.indexOf(shots[0]), check + ' runs before the shots');
}
assert(main.some(l => /^if defined CHECKFAIL set "FAILED=/.test(l.s)), 'CHECKFAIL becomes FAILED before the shots');
const fresh = main.findIndex(l => /LastWriteTimeUtc\.Ticks -lt \[long\]\$env:START_TICKS/.test(l.s));
assert(fresh > 0 && fresh < main.findIndex(l => l.s.includes('installed_ship_check.gd')), 'the installed glb must be this run\'s before any check');
assert(/for %%S in \(%STAGES%\) do call :stage %%S/.test(text), 'the stages loop runs STAGES in order');
const stage = text.slice(text.indexOf(':stage'));
assert(/if defined FAILED \(\s*\r?\n\s*echo %1 SKIPPED/.test(stage), 'a failed stage skips the later stages');
const co = main.findIndex(l => /checkout -q --no-overwrite-ignore -B shipjob FETCH_HEAD/.test(l.s));
assert(!/checkout[^\r\n]* -f\b|checkout[^\r\n]*--force/.test(text), 'never a forced checkout: it would replace untracked or ignored local files');
assert(main.some(l => /merge -q --no-edit --no-overwrite-ignore FETCH_HEAD/.test(l.s)), 'the PAINT_BASE merge refuses to overwrite ignored files too');
assert(main.slice(0, co).some(l => /^git -C "%C%" checkout -q HEAD -- godot\/assets\/ships /.test(l.s)), 'only the install folder is restored');
const pre = main.slice(0, co).map(l => l.s);
assert(co > 0 && pre.some(s => /status --porcelain/.test(s)) && pre.some(s => /diff --binary HEAD > "%O%\\clone_changes_before_checkout\.patch"/.test(s)),
  'every local change in the clone is listed and saved before the forced checkout');
const unexpected = pre.findIndex(s => /status --porcelain --untracked-files=no -- \. ":\(exclude\)godot\/assets\/ships" ":\(glob,exclude\)godot\/\*\*\/\*\.import" > "%O%\\clone_changes_unexpected\.txt"/.test(s));
assert(unexpected > 0 && /set "FAILED=checkout: git status/.test(pre[unexpected + 1]) && guard.test(pre[unexpected + 2])
  && /set "FAILED=checkout: the clone has local changes outside/.test(pre[unexpected + 3]) && guard.test(pre[unexpected + 4]),
  'a change outside godot/assets/ships and the rewritten *.import files stops the job before the checkout (git filters, not findstr: PR 1190)');
assert(!pre.some(s => /findstr/.test(s)), 'no findstr filter on the git status list (its $ needs a CR)');
assert(main.slice(0, co).some(l => /^git -C "%C%" checkout -q HEAD -- ":\(glob\)godot\/\*\*\/\*\.import" /.test(l.s)), 'the rewritten *.import files are restored after the patch is saved');
pass('the guard: a failed fetch, merge, import, stage, install or check never reaches the shots; all three checks count');

// the wait default
const wait = code.findIndex(l => /^if not defined PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS set PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS=3600$/.test(l.s));
assert(wait > 0, 'PC_GPU_WAIT_SECONDS defaults to 3600');
assert(wait < code.findIndex(l => /tmo\.bat/.test(l.s)), 'the wait default is set before the first GPU step');
const { MAX_WAIT_SECONDS } = require(path.join(ROOT, 'tools/pc/gpu_slots.js'));
assert.equal(MAX_WAIT_SECONDS, 3600, 'the default is the most gpu_slots.js accepts');
pass('the GPU wait: 3600 s by default for every GPU step, accepted by gpu_slots.js');

// the last line
const finish = code.findIndex(l => l.s === ':finish');
const tailLines = code.slice(finish).map(l => l.s);
assert.deepEqual(tailLines.slice(1, 8), ['if defined FAILED goto finish_failed', 'echo done PASS %DATE% %TIME% >> "%RES%"',
  'echo all done >> "%RES%"', 'exit /b 0', ':finish_failed', 'echo done FAILED: %FAILED% %DATE% %TIME% >> "%RES%"',
  'echo all done >> "%RES%"']);
const start = code.findIndex(l => /^echo start /.test(l.s));
const subs = code.findIndex(l => l.s === ':ship');
for (let i = start; i < subs; i++) {
  if (/exit \/b/i.test(code[i].s)) assert(i > finish, `line ${code[i].n} leaves the job before the done and all done lines`);
}
for (const l of code.slice(start, finish)) {
  if (/goto (\w+)/i.test(l.s)) assert(['collect', 'finish', 'based'].includes(/goto (\w+)/i.exec(l.s)[1]), `line ${l.n}: ${l.s}`);
}
pass('the last line: every way out of the job writes done PASS or done FAILED, then all done');

// no deletes, output only in the job folder
for (const l of code) {
  assert(!/^(del|erase|rd|rmdir|move)\b/i.test(l.s) && !/\b(del|rmdir|rd) \/[sq]/i.test(l.s), `line ${l.n} deletes or moves: ${l.s}`);
  for (const m of l.s.matchAll(/>>?\s*("[^"]*"|\S+)/g)) {
    const target = m[1].replace(/"/g, '');
    if (target === 'nul' || target === '&1') continue;
    assert(/^%(O|RES)%/.test(target), `line ${l.n} writes outside the job's out folder: ${target}`);
  }
}
assert(/^ren "%O%" "out_before_%STAMP%"$/m.test(text.replace(/^if exist "%O%" /m, '')), 'an earlier out folder is renamed, not removed');
assert(/^xcopy \/e \/i \/y \/q "%V%\\recipe\\%SHIP%" "%O%\\recipe"/m.test(text), 'the recipe folder is copied, never moved');
pass('no deletes or moves; logs only under out; the recipe folder copied into out\\recipe');

// the wrappers
const wrappers = fs.existsSync(WRAPPERS) ? fs.readdirSync(WRAPPERS).filter(f => /\.bat$/i.test(f)) : [];
assert(wrappers.length >= 1, 'at least one wrapper (the S10 port) in docs/ship_pipeline/ship_job/wrappers');
for (const f of wrappers) {
  const w = fs.readFileSync(path.join(WRAPPERS, f), 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim());
  assert.equal(w.length, 3, f + ' is three lines');
  assert.equal(w[0].trim(), '@echo off', f);
  for (const v of ['SHIP', 'CODE', 'BRANCH', 'JOB_DIR']) assert(new RegExp(`set "${v}=[^"]+"`).test(w[1]), `${f} sets ${v}`);
  assert(/^call "%USERPROFILE%\\Downloads\\voidsworn_test\\ship_job\\ship_job\.bat"$/.test(w[2].trim()), f + ' calls the shared copy');
}
pass(`the wrappers: ${wrappers.length} three-line wrapper(s) set the inputs and call the shared job`);
console.log(`PASS ship job checks (${passed} groups)`);

function State($status, $reason) {
  $p = Join-Path $script:out 'status.json'
  $s = Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  $s.status = $status; $s.reason = $reason
  $s.finished = if ($status -eq 'running') { '' } else { [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o') }
  $s.commit = Read (Join-Path $script:out 'run_commit.txt')
  Save-State $s
}
function Save-State($s) {
  $p = Join-Path $script:out 'status.json'
  # Replace in place atomically so a waiter never sees half a JSON document.
  $tmp = "$p.$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')).tmp"
  Put $tmp ($s | ConvertTo-Json)
  [IO.File]::Replace($tmp, $p, "$tmp.previous")
}
function Git([string[]]$words) {

  $ErrorActionPreference = $ea
  # Writing the log must never fail the job (Nov 16: four starts died when another process briefly held git_log.txt,
  # 'The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process'). One append, retried, never thrown.
  $text = (@($lines | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) -join "`r`n")
  if ($script:out -and $text) {

  }

}

+# R339. Build and read back a backup before the janitor can remove a checkout with local work.
+function Salvage-Git([string[]]$words, [string[]]$inputLines) {
+  $lines = @(Git $words $inputLines)
+  if ($gitExit -ne 0) { throw "salvage Git failed ($($words -join ' ')): $($lines -join ' ')" }
+  return $lines
+}
+function Set-SalvageObjects($gitDir, $objects) {
+  $objects = Get-Item -LiteralPath $objects -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $objects
+  Put (Join-Path $gitDir 'objects/info/alternates') ($objects.FullName.Replace('\','/') + "`n")
+}
+function Save-SalvageBundle($scratch, $backup, $mirror, $state, $objectFormat) {
+  $updates = @(); $refs = @(); $parents = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]'
+  foreach ($line in $state.Local) {
+    $id, $ancestry = $line -split ' ', 2
+    $ref = "refs/salvage/$id"
+    $updates += "create $ref $id"
+    $refs += "$id $ref"
+    foreach ($parent in ($ancestry -split ' ')) {
+      if ($state.MirrorCommits.Contains($parent)) { $null = $parents.Add("^$parent") }
+    }
+  }
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'update-ref','--stdin') $updates
+  $bundle = Join-Path $backup 'salvage.bundle'
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'bundle','create',$bundle,'--glob=refs/salvage/*','--stdin') @($parents)
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$mirror,'bundle','verify',$bundle)
+  $found = @(Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'bundle','list-heads',$bundle))
+  if (Compare-Object $refs $found) { throw 'salvage bundle refs differ from local history' }
+
+  # Unpack without the source objects, then check that every advertised commit is recoverable.
+  $verify = Join-Path $scratch 'verify.git'
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('init','--quiet','--bare',"--object-format=$objectFormat",$verify)
+  Set-SalvageObjects $verify (Join-Path $mirror 'objects')
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$verify,'bundle','unbundle',$bundle)
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$verify,'update-ref','--stdin') $updates
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$verify,'fsck','--connectivity-only','--no-reflogs')
+}
+function Save-SalvageZip($repo, $backup, $state) {
+  Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
+  $paths = @(foreach ($line in $state.Status) {
+    if (-not $line.StartsWith('?? ')) { continue }
+    if ($line -notmatch '^\?\? ("?)([^"\\:\r\n]+)(?<!/)\1$') { throw "untracked path cannot be verified: $line" }
+    $entry = $Matches[2]
+    if ($entry -notin $state.Caches) { $entry }
+  })
+  $zip = Join-Path $backup 'untracked.zip'
+  $archive = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($zip, 'Create')
+  try {
+    foreach ($path in $paths) {
+      $file = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo $path) -Force
+      if ($file -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($file.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { throw "untracked file could not be read: $path" }
+      Assert-PlainDirectory $file.Directory
+      $null = [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($archive, $file.FullName, $path)
+    }
+  } finally { $archive.Dispose() }
+
+  $archive = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zip)
+  $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
+  try {
+    if ($archive.Entries.Count -ne $paths.Count) { throw 'salvage zip file count differs' }
+    foreach ($path in $paths) {
+      $entry = $archive.GetEntry($path)
+      if (-not $entry) { throw "salvage zip is missing $path" }
+      $stream = $entry.Open()
+      try { $digest = [BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($stream)).Replace('-','') }
+      finally { $stream.Dispose() }
+      if ($digest -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo $path) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw "salvage zip differs for $path" }
+    }
+  } finally { $sha.Dispose(); $archive.Dispose() }
+}
+function Save-CheckoutSalvage($repo, $mirror, $state, $dest) {
+  $root = Split-Path -Parent $dest
+  $dir = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($root)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  $staging = Join-Path $root ".checking-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
+  $scratch = Join-Path $staging 'scratch'
+  $backup = Join-Path $staging 'backup'
+  $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($backup)
+  try {
+    $index = @(Salvage-Git @('-C',$repo,'ls-files','--stage'))
+    if ($index -match '^(?:160000 |[0-9]+ [0-9a-f]+ [123]\t)') { throw 'salvage cannot verify submodules or an unmerged index' }
+    $head = (Salvage-Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','--verify','HEAD'))[0]
+    $objectFormat = (Salvage-Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','--show-object-format'))[0]
+    $null = Salvage-Git @('init','--quiet',"--object-format=$objectFormat",$scratch)
+    Set-SalvageObjects (Join-Path $scratch '.git') (Join-Path $repo '.git/objects')
+    # Load HEAD's tree in the scratch worktree index without copying the game assets into its working directory.
+    $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'read-tree',$head)
+    $base = @('--no-optional-locks','-C',$repo,'diff','--no-ext-diff','--no-textconv','--binary','--full-index','--no-color','--no-relative','--src-prefix=a/','--dst-prefix=b/')
+    foreach ($name in @('salvage.patch','salvage-index.patch')) {
+      $file = Join-Path $backup $name
+      $options = if ($name -eq 'salvage-index.patch') { @('--cached') } else { @() }
+      $null = Salvage-Git ($base + @($options) + @("--output=$file",$head,'--'))
+      if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $file).Length) {
+        $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'apply','--check','--cached',$file)
+      }
+    }
+    if ($state.Local.Count) { Save-SalvageBundle $scratch $backup $mirror $state $objectFormat }
+    Save-SalvageZip $repo $backup $state
+    Put (Join-Path $backup 'HEAD.txt') ($head + "`n")
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    # Directory.Move fails if a prior backup already exists. Never overwrite checked salvage.
+    [IO.Directory]::Move($backup, $dest)
+    foreach ($file in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $dest).EnumerateFiles()) { Log "salvage verified: $($file.FullName) ($($file.Length) bytes)" }
+  } finally {
+    try {
+      $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Force
+      Assert-NoLinkedChildren $staging
+      Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    } catch { Log "salvage scratch kept: $staging ($($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+}

+function Clear-WorkRunRepos($runs, $mirror, $dryRun, $now, $temp, $salvageRoot, $activeLegacy) {
+  foreach ($run in $runs) {
+    $repo = Get-Item -LiteralPath $run.Repo -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    if (-not $repo) { continue }
+    $issueLock = $null; $checkoutLock = $null; $reason = ''
+    try {
+      Assert-PlainDirectory $repo.Parent
+      $issueLock = Open-CleanupLock (Issue-LockPath $run.Issue $temp) $dryRun
+      $checkoutLock = Open-CleanupLock ($run.Repo + '.checkout.lock') $true
+    } catch { $reason = 'run lock is held or could not be verified' }
+    try {
+      if (-not $reason -and ($activeLegacy -contains $run.Issue -or
+          -not $run.State.finished -or $run.State.status -notin @('checked_push','unverified','partial','failed','no_changes'))) {
+        $reason = 'run ending could not be verified or issue is active'
+      }
+      Clear-KeptCheckout $repo $mirror $dryRun $now $salvageRoot "work217_$($run.Name)" $reason
+    } finally {
+      if ($checkoutLock) { $checkoutLock.Dispose() }
+      if ($issueLock) { $issueLock.Dispose() }
+    }
+  }

+# R339. Build and read back a backup before the janitor can remove a checkout with local work.
+function Salvage-Git([string[]]$words, [string[]]$inputLines) {
+  $lines = @(Git $words $inputLines)
+  if ($gitExit -ne 0) { throw "salvage Git failed ($($words -join ' ')): $($lines -join ' ')" }
+  return $lines
+}
+function Set-SalvageObjects($gitDir, $objects) {
+  $objects = Get-Item -LiteralPath $objects -Force
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $objects
+  Put (Join-Path $gitDir 'objects/info/alternates') ($objects.FullName.Replace('\','/') + "`n")
+}
+function Save-SalvageBundle($scratch, $backup, $mirror, $state, $objectFormat) {
+  $updates = @(); $refs = @(); $parents = New-Object 'Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]'
+  foreach ($line in $state.Local) {
+    $id, $ancestry = $line -split ' ', 2
+    $ref = "refs/salvage/$id"
+    $updates += "create $ref $id"
+    $refs += "$id $ref"
+    foreach ($parent in ($ancestry -split ' ')) {
+      if ($state.MirrorCommits.Contains($parent)) { $null = $parents.Add("^$parent") }
+    }
+  }
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'update-ref','--stdin') $updates
+  $bundle = Join-Path $backup 'salvage.bundle'
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'bundle','create',$bundle,'--glob=refs/salvage/*','--stdin') @($parents)
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$mirror,'bundle','verify',$bundle)
+  $found = @(Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'bundle','list-heads',$bundle))
+  if (Compare-Object $refs $found) { throw 'salvage bundle refs differ from local history' }
+
+  # Unpack without the source objects, then check that every advertised commit is recoverable.
+  $verify = Join-Path $scratch 'verify.git'
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('init','--quiet','--bare',"--object-format=$objectFormat",$verify)
+  Set-SalvageObjects $verify (Join-Path $mirror 'objects')
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$verify,'bundle','unbundle',$bundle)
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$verify,'update-ref','--stdin') $updates
+  $null = Salvage-Git @('--git-dir',$verify,'fsck','--connectivity-only','--no-reflogs')
+}
+function Save-SalvageZip($repo, $backup, $state) {
+  Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
+  $paths = @(foreach ($line in $state.Status) {
+    if (-not $line.StartsWith('?? ')) { continue }
+    if ($line -notmatch '^\?\? ("?)([^"\\:\r\n]+)(?<!/)\1$') { throw "untracked path cannot be verified: $line" }
+    $entry = $Matches[2]
+    if ($entry -notin $state.Caches) { $entry }
+  })
+  $zip = Join-Path $backup 'untracked.zip'
+  $archive = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($zip, 'Create')
+  try {
+    foreach ($path in $paths) {
+      $file = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo $path) -Force
+      if ($file -isnot [IO.FileInfo] -or ($file.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { throw "untracked file could not be read: $path" }
+      Assert-PlainDirectory $file.Directory
+      $null = [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($archive, $file.FullName, $path)
+    }
+  } finally { $archive.Dispose() }
+
+  $archive = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zip)
+  $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
+  try {
+    if ($archive.Entries.Count -ne $paths.Count) { throw 'salvage zip file count differs' }
+    foreach ($path in $paths) {
+      $entry = $archive.GetEntry($path)
+      if (-not $entry) { throw "salvage zip is missing $path" }
+      $stream = $entry.Open()
+      try { $digest = [BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($stream)).Replace('-','') }
+      finally { $stream.Dispose() }
+      if ($digest -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo $path) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw "salvage zip differs for $path" }
+    }
+  } finally { $sha.Dispose(); $archive.Dispose() }
+}
+function Save-CheckoutSalvage($repo, $mirror, $state, $dest) {
+  $root = Split-Path -Parent $dest
+  $dir = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($root)
+  Assert-PlainDirectory $dir
+  $staging = Join-Path $root ".checking-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
+  $scratch = Join-Path $staging 'scratch'
+  $backup = Join-Path $staging 'backup'
+  $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($backup)
+  try {
+    $index = @(Salvage-Git @('-C',$repo,'ls-files','--stage'))
+    if ($index -match '^(?:160000 |[0-9]+ [0-9a-f]+ [123]\t)') { throw 'salvage cannot verify submodules or an unmerged index' }
+    $head = (Salvage-Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','--verify','HEAD'))[0]
+    $objectFormat = (Salvage-Git @('-C',$repo,'rev-parse','--show-object-format'))[0]
+    $null = Salvage-Git @('init','--quiet',"--object-format=$objectFormat",$scratch)
+    Set-SalvageObjects (Join-Path $scratch '.git') (Join-Path $repo '.git/objects')
+    # Load HEAD's tree in the scratch worktree index without copying the game assets into its working directory.
+    $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'read-tree',$head)
+    $base = @('--no-optional-locks','-C',$repo,'diff','--no-ext-diff','--no-textconv','--binary','--full-index','--no-color','--no-relative','--src-prefix=a/','--dst-prefix=b/')
+    foreach ($name in @('salvage.patch','salvage-index.patch')) {
+      $file = Join-Path $backup $name
+      $options = if ($name -eq 'salvage-index.patch') { @('--cached') } else { @() }
+      $null = Salvage-Git ($base + @($options) + @("--output=$file",$head,'--'))
+      if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $file).Length) {
+        $null = Salvage-Git @('-C',$scratch,'apply','--check','--cached',$file)
+      }
+    }
+    if ($state.Local.Count) { Save-SalvageBundle $scratch $backup $mirror $state $objectFormat }
+    Save-SalvageZip $repo $backup $state
+    Put (Join-Path $backup 'HEAD.txt') ($head + "`n")
+    if (Cleanup-Paused) { throw 'PC pause is active' }
+    # Directory.Move fails if a prior backup already exists. Never overwrite checked salvage.
+    [IO.Directory]::Move($backup, $dest)
+    foreach ($file in (Get-Item -LiteralPath $dest).EnumerateFiles()) { Log "salvage verified: $($file.FullName) ($($file.Length) bytes)" }
+  } finally {
+    try {
+      $dir = Get-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Force
+      Assert-NoLinkedChildren $staging
+      Remove-CleanupDirectory $dir
+    } catch { Log "salvage scratch kept: $staging ($($_.Exception.Message))" }
+  }
+}

   $ea = $ErrorActionPreference; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
